description: Entity extract. Any text in, URL-encoded as the text query parameter (up to 12,000 bytes), an extraction out: eight families (emails, URLs, ISO dates, US dates, money, percentages, organizations, cashtag tickers), every match with its occurrence count and first line, the full pattern set published verbatim in the result. Price: $0.10 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.

text.description: The text to scan for entities (up to 12,000 bytes).
